description: This file appears to be a shell script containing test cases for verifying directory traversal and untracked/ignored files handling in git. It sets up various git repository states and validates the output of 'git ls-files' and 'git status' commands to ensure correct behavior in different scenarios involving directory prefixes, ignores, and recursion.

methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided file or output is empty.
